20e1c63e-791f-43a8-bb33-84ebfe166368.title: Oyna bilan qorin ustida mashq
20e1c63e-791f-43a8-bb33-84ebfe166368.description: Chaqaloqning o‘zini oynada ko‘rishi uning rivojlanishini rag‘batlantiradi
20e1c63e-791f-43a8-bb33-84ebfe166368.instructions: Chaqaloqni qorni bilan yostiq ustiga yotqizing. Uning oldiga oyna qo‘ying. Oynada o‘zini ko‘rsating.

5a6d5c7d-3489-4b3d-8210-fbeed43d3536.title: Oshxona orkestri
5a6d5c7d-3489-4b3d-8210-fbeed43d3536.description: Qozon va tovachalar yordamida ritmni rivojlantirish
5a6d5c7d-3489-4b3d-8210-fbeed43d3536.instructions: Yog‘och qoshiq va qozonlarni chaqaloqning oldiga qo‘ying. Ularni qanday urishni ko‘rsating. Birgalikda ritm yarating.

8266c528-ae95-47fa-b7f4-28400410ebc2.title: Qutidan tunnel
8266c528-ae95-47fa-b7f4-28400410ebc2.instructions: Katta karton qutining har ikki tomonini oching. Chaqaloqni bir tomondan emaklab kirishga undang. Uni boshqa tomondan chaqiring.

fc6ee2c8-0599-4677-994a-dc1385d83024.title: Paypoq qo‘g‘irchoqlar
fc6ee2c8-0599-4677-994a-dc1385d83024.instructions: Eski paypoqdan qo‘g‘irchoq yasang. Chaqaloq bilan "gaplashing". Turli tovushlar chiqaring.

3b19cf38-0d12-4b49-81d4-69a60f7b3cc2.title: Turli teksturalar bo‘ylab sayr
3b19cf38-0d12-4b49-81d4-69a60f7b3cc2.instructions: Turli teksturali materiallarni (ko‘rpa, sharf, qog‘oz) yerga yoying. Chaqaloqqa ular ustidan emaklashga imkon bering.

16373dad-486f-490c-bc14-144cfd354f5f.title: Yuqori kontrastli kartochkalar
16373dad-486f-490c-bc14-144cfd354f5f.description: Ko‘rish qobiliyatini rivojlantirish uchun oq-qora naqshli kartochkalar
16373dad-486f-490c-bc14-144cfd354f5f.instructions: 1. Kartochkani chaqaloqning yuzidan 20-30cm masofada tuting\n2. Uni sekin chapdan o‘ngga siljiting\n3. Chaqaloq kartochkani ko‘zlari bilan kuzatishini kuzating

58d3e4f3-7256-4eaa-901e-ce192a8aca44.title: Mato bilan «Ku-ku» o‘yini
58d3e4f3-7256-4eaa-901e-ce192a8aca44.instructions:
1. Yuzingizni mato bilan yoping
2. «Men qayerdaman?» deb ayting
3. Matoni olib, «Ku-ku!» deb ayting
4. Chaqaloqning yuzini ohista yoping va takrorlang

8c2f484b-326a-4dac-b7a4-7eb528aff395.title: Oq-qora osma o‘yinchoq
8c2f484b-326a-4dac-b7a4-7eb528aff395.instructions: Qog‘ozdan oddiy shakllarni kesib, ularni chaqaloqdan 20-30cm balandlikda osing. Chaqaloq harakatni ko‘zlari bilan kuzatsin.

6145784f-e184-4ae7-8691-ff33671cc7d0.title: Stakanchalarni taxlash
6145784f-e184-4ae7-8691-ff33671cc7d0.instructions:
1. Chaqaloqqa stakanchalarni qanday taxlashni ko‘rsating
2. Chaqaloq ularni yiqitsin
3. Qayta quring va takrorlang
4. Taxlayotganda ranglarni ayting

68d82e2b-fe11-4b41-af57-aa141f8eb6cc.title: Rasmli kitob o‘qish
68d82e2b-fe11-4b41-af57-aa141f8eb6cc.instructions:
1. Yorqin rasmlari bor kitoblarni tanlang
2. Rasmlarni ko‘rsatib, ularning nomini ayting
3. Chaqaloq sahifalarni varaqlasin
4. Hayvonlarning ovozlariga taqlid qiling

60e5d3d1-5587-48f5-99df-4e806c62490a.title: Shakllarni saralash o‘yini
60e5d3d1-5587-48f5-99df-4e806c62490a.instructions:
1. Shakllarni mos teshiklarga qanday joylashni ko‘rsating
2. Avvaliga chaqaloqning qo‘lini yo‘naltiring
3. Muvaffaqiyatini quvonch bilan olqishlang
4. O‘ynayotganda shakllarning nomini ayting

52245d35-3235-4e80-b73d-af4fe323ed93.title: Raqs kechasi
52245d35-3235-4e80-b73d-af4fe323ed93.instructions:
1. Quvnoq musiqa qo‘ying
2. Chaqaloqni qo‘lingizga olib raqsga tushing
3. Chaqaloqni yerga qo‘yib, birga raqsga tushing
4. Qarsak chaling va aylaning

c1e1e351-1af5-4816-8f2c-de374135c16b.title: Ko‘zgu bilan qorincha mashqi
c1e1e351-1af5-4816-8f2c-de374135c16b.description: Chaqaloqni qiziqtirish uchun ko‘zgu yordamida qorin bilan yotish mashqi
c1e1e351-1af5-4816-8f2c-de374135c16b.instructions: 1. Chaqaloqni yumshoq joyga qorni bilan yotqizing\n2. Uning qarshisiga ko‘zgu qo‘ying\n3. Chaqaloq bilan gaplashing va boshini ko‘tarib qarashga undang

ea46fd4e-7a05-4463-bf0d-2b9e8add8866.title: Mayin massaj vaqti
ea46fd4e-7a05-4463-bf0d-2b9e8add8866.description: Chaqaloq bilan mehr rishtalarini mustahkamlash va uning rivojlanishi uchun massaj
ea46fd4e-7a05-4463-bf0d-2b9e8add8866.instructions: 1. Chaqaloqlar uchun xavfsiz moydan foydalaning\n2. Qo‘llari, oyoqlari va qornini ohista massaj qiling\n3. Massaj paytida qo‘shiq ayting yoki chaqaloq bilan gaplashing

449a2aa8-5640-4e79-b7fa-0c92027bb12c.title: Sovun pufakchalarini kuzatish
449a2aa8-5640-4e79-b7fa-0c92027bb12c.description: Ko‘z bilan kuzatish qobiliyatini rivojlantirish uchun sovun pufakchalarini tomosha qilish
449a2aa8-5640-4e79-b7fa-0c92027bb12c.instructions: 1. Chaqaloq yaqinida sovun pufakchalarini puflang\n2. Pufakchalarni ko‘rsatib, ularni tasvirlab bering\n3. Pufakchalar chaqaloqning terisiga tegib, ohista yorilishiga imkon bering

e257be70-2380-44c1-91be-9e079d4879b7.title: Turli yuzalarni o‘rganish
e257be70-2380-44c1-91be-9e079d4879b7.instructions: 1. Turli tuzilishga ega buyumlarni to‘plang\n2. Chaqaloqqa har bir buyumni ushlab ko‘rishga imkon bering\n3. Ularning tuzilishini ta’riflang: yumshoq, dag‘al, silliq

4d841e68-97b6-4186-be6e-26bef3df65df.title: Idish bilan o‘ynash
4d841e68-97b6-4186-be6e-26bef3df65df.description: Buyumlarni idishga solish va undan chiqarish
4d841e68-97b6-4186-be6e-26bef3df65df.instructions:
1. Xavfsiz idish va yumshoq o‘yinchoqlardan foydalaning
2. Chaqaloqqa buyumlarni idishga qanday solishni ko‘rsating
3. Chaqaloqni buyumlarni idishdan chiqarishga undang
4. Qarsak chalib, uni olqishlang

073a2084-da2c-4ef3-8a93-22136a2c77a5.title: To‘pni dumalatish
073a2084-da2c-4ef3-8a93-22136a2c77a5.instructions:
1. Chaqaloqning qarshisiga o‘tiring
2. Yumshoq to‘pni chaqaloq tomon dumalating
3. Chaqaloqni to‘pni sizga qaytarib dumalatishga undang
4. Chaqaloq o‘yinda qatnashganda uni olqishlang

ea96ae3c-ed32-4118-b146-ecbb3a3bb763.title: Shiqildoqni kuzatish
ea96ae3c-ed32-4118-b146-ecbb3a3bb763.description: Shiqildoqni ko‘z va quloq bilan kuzatish
ea96ae3c-ed32-4118-b146-ecbb3a3bb763.instructions: 1. Chaqaloqning e’tiborini jalb qilish uchun shiqildoqni silkiting\n2. Uni turli yo‘nalishlarda sekin harakatlantiring\n3. Chaqaloqqa uni ushlashga harakat qilishiga imkon bering

e08ba272-48b6-4a5f-b44b-0ba7da5cb808.title: Telefon orqali soxta suhbat
e08ba272-48b6-4a5f-b44b-0ba7da5cb808.instructions:
1. Chaqaloqqa o‘yinchoq telefon bering
2. Unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilayotgandek bo‘ling
3. Chaqaloqni «gapirishga» undang
4. Navbatma-navbat gapiring

a3c29297-6e01-48c7-9b34-d7d9d3af361a.title: Mayin kuylash
a3c29297-6e01-48c7-9b34-d7d9d3af361a.instructions: Chaqaloqni bag‘ringizga bosib, mayin alla yoki oddiy qo‘shiqlar kuylang. Chaqaloq ovozingizga qanday javob berayotganini kuzating.

e0e77763-f782-46a8-bcfe-1cf276ba2cce.title: O‘yinchoqlar bilan qorincha vaqti
e0e77763-f782-46a8-bcfe-1cf276ba2cce.description: Qorincha vaqtida oldiga rang-barang o‘yinchoqlar qo‘ying
e0e77763-f782-46a8-bcfe-1cf276ba2cce.instructions: Chaqaloqni qorni bilan yotqizing. Qo‘l uzatishi va boshini ko‘tarishiga undash uchun rang-barang o‘yinchoqlarni qo‘li yetmaydigan masofaga qo‘ying.

5cea30c3-38d1-4326-b521-b5428eba62a1.title: Suvni sachratish vaqti
5cea30c3-38d1-4326-b521-b5428eba62a1.description: Chaqaloqqa suvni qo‘llari bilan sachratishiga imkon bering
5cea30c3-38d1-4326-b521-b5428eba62a1.instructions: Sayoz idishni iliq suv bilan to‘ldiring. Chaqaloqqa suvga tegib, uni sachratishiga imkon bering. Uni doimo diqqat bilan kuzatib turing.

eb368346-4c28-48f4-acc2-82c3747e66bf.title: Uchayotgan chaqaloq
eb368346-4c28-48f4-acc2-82c3747e66bf.instructions: Chalqancha yoting, chaqaloqni mahkam ushlab, uchayotgandek ehtiyotkorlik bilan yuqoriga ko‘taring. Bu o‘zaro mehr rishtalarini mustahkamlash uchun juda foydali.

ebc79f1e-7d23-4c5a-b28e-dda90e096b3a.title: Xazinalar savati
ebc79f1e-7d23-4c5a-b28e-dda90e096b3a.description: Savatni xavfsiz uy-ro‘zg‘or buyumlari bilan to‘ldiring
ebc79f1e-7d23-4c5a-b28e-dda90e096b3a.instructions: Turli tuzilish va shakldagi 5-10 ta xavfsiz buyumni to‘plang. Har bir buyumning nomini aytib, chaqaloqqa ularni erkin o‘rganishiga imkon bering.

a4aa194b-9d64-4f72-8ba4-90ae6e12f0c5.title: Qarsak qo‘shig‘i
a4aa194b-9d64-4f72-8ba4-90ae6e12f0c5.instructions: Qarsak chalib aytiladigan sodda qo‘shiqlarni kuylang. Chaqaloqqa kaftlarini bir-biriga urib, qarsak chalishga yordam bering. Bu ritmni his qilish va harakatlarni muvofiqlashtirish uchun juda foydali.

b99f62da-0ba0-4a8c-a136-3eae65f486ee.title: Qoshiq tashlash o‘yini
b99f62da-0ba0-4a8c-a136-3eae65f486ee.instructions: Chaqaloqqa yog‘och qoshiqlarni qozonga qanday tashlashni ko‘rsating. Unga chiqayotgan tovushni eshitib, harakatni takrorlashiga imkon bering.

bf6bdf5d-9977-460c-978a-4df325af6d86.title: Paxta bo‘laklarini ko‘chirish
bf6bdf5d-9977-460c-978a-4df325af6d86.description: Paxta bo‘laklarini bir idishdan boshqasiga ko‘chiring
bf6bdf5d-9977-460c-978a-4df325af6d86.instructions: Chaqaloqqa ikkita kosa va paxta bo‘laklarini bering. Ularni qanday olib, bir kosadan boshqasiga ko‘chirishni ko‘rsating. Bu mayda motorikani rivojlantirish uchun juda foydali.

c80230e8-6d2c-459b-9557-6ff0795bbec7.title: Qog‘oz yirtish
c80230e8-6d2c-459b-9557-6ff0795bbec7.instructions: Chaqaloqqa yirtish uchun yumshoq qog‘oz bering. Uning tovushi va qo‘lda sezilishi hissiy idrokni rivojlantirib, qo‘llarni mustahkamlaydi.

977ee460-5cf3-4eaa-878a-9d316320f9a5.title: Karton naychali tunnel
977ee460-5cf3-4eaa-878a-9d316320f9a5.instructions: Karton naychani ushlab, chaqaloqqa kichik koptokni uning ichidan qanday dumalatishni ko‘rsating. So‘ng koptokning ortidan birga quving.

df24840d-33ce-4c49-b093-3e0206c89ed5.title: Gubkani siqish
df24840d-33ce-4c49-b093-3e0206c89ed5.description: Ho‘l gubkalarni siqib, suvini idishlarga tushiring
df24840d-33ce-4c49-b093-3e0206c89ed5.instructions: Gubkalarni ho‘llang va chaqaloqqa suvini idishga qanday siqib tushirishni ko‘rsating. Bu qo‘l mushaklarini mustahkamlash uchun juda foydali.

efd51de1-efff-48a2-a2e9-f6a4a3d7a2ee.title: Patlarni puflash
efd51de1-efff-48a2-a2e9-f6a4a3d7a2ee.description: Patlarni puflang va ularning havoda suzishini kuzating
efd51de1-efff-48a2-a2e9-f6a4a3d7a2ee.instructions: Patlarni tekis yuzaga qo‘ying. Ularni ohista puflang va chaqaloqqa ham tutib olish yoki puflashga urinib ko‘rishiga imkon bering.

53ef4599-988b-4a29-8f82-c3c78d48283b.title: Qum bilan o‘ynash
53ef4599-988b-4a29-8f82-c3c78d48283b.description: Qumni kavlang va bir idishdan boshqasiga soling
53ef4599-988b-4a29-8f82-c3c78d48283b.instructions: Patnisni qum bilan to‘ldiring. Stakanlar va qoshiqlar bering. Chaqaloqqa qumni kavlash, bir idishdan boshqasiga solish va uning tuzilishini his qilishiga imkon bering.

9a13c43a-a835-47cf-99fe-bd97a0f1562c.title: O‘yin xamirini ezish
9a13c43a-a835-47cf-99fe-bd97a0f1562c.description: O‘yin xamirini ezing, dumalating va shakl bering
9a13c43a-a835-47cf-99fe-bd97a0f1562c.instructions: Chaqaloqqa o‘yin xamiri bering. Uni ezish, dumalatish va barmoq bilan bosishni ko‘rsating. Shakllar yasash uchun pechenye qoliplaridan foydalaning.

5c63d4c6-a28a-488e-84cb-86ad690cd854.title: Kublardan minora
5c63d4c6-a28a-488e-84cb-86ad690cd854.instructions: Chaqaloqqa kublarni qanday taxlashni ko‘rsating. Har bir kubni sanang. Minora qulaganda birgalikda quvoning! Uni birga qayta quring.

00ca6e21-d67f-4f0a-a874-ef5c64e2e91a.title: Sharflarni tortib chiqarish
00ca6e21-d67f-4f0a-a874-ef5c64e2e91a.instructions: Sharflarni teshigi bor qutiga joylang. Chaqaloqqa ularni birma-bir tortib chiqarishga imkon bering. Har birining rangini ayting.

94152e25-5d19-43e0-9c7f-26f0205d234e.title: Suv quyish
94152e25-5d19-43e0-9c7f-26f0205d234e.instructions: Chaqaloqqa ikkita stakan va suv bering. Suvni biridan boshqasiga qanday quyishni ko‘rsating. Bu harakatlarni muvofiqlashtirish uchun juda foydali.

18e16dc8-b896-4c03-8b0c-c7052e294b98.title: Yashirilgan o‘yinchoqni topish
18e16dc8-b896-4c03-8b0c-c7052e294b98.description: O‘yinchoqni stakanlardan birining ostiga yashirib, toping
18e16dc8-b896-4c03-8b0c-c7052e294b98.instructions: 2-3 ta stakanni teskari qo‘ying. Ulardan birining ostiga kichik o‘yinchoqni yashiring. Chaqaloqdan uni topishini so‘rang.

a9054a6e-ef97-45fa-aea0-e0e0cc640bc3.title: Ranglar bo‘yicha saralash
a9054a6e-ef97-45fa-aea0-e0e0cc640bc3.instructions: Turli rangdagi buyumlardan (kublar, to‘plar, qopqoqlar) foydalaning. Idishlarni qo‘yib, boladan buyumlarni rangiga qarab saralashini so‘rang.

07108cc6-ef41-4d92-ad52-d3d9ab5b5c1a.title: Tana qismlari o‘yini
07108cc6-ef41-4d92-ad52-d3d9ab5b5c1a.description: Tana qismlarini ko‘rsating va nomini ayting
07108cc6-ef41-4d92-ad52-d3d9ab5b5c1a.instructions: Burun, quloq va ko‘zlaringizga tegib, ularning nomini ayting. Boladan sizga taqlid qilishini so‘rang. Bosh, yelka va tizzalar haqidagi qo‘shiqni birga kuylang.

61ed8f13-2ee8-4bf5-b395-427c971b2b93.title: Menga ergashing
61ed8f13-2ee8-4bf5-b395-427c971b2b93.instructions: Oddiy harakatlarni bajaring: sakrang, qarsak chaling, aylaning, oyoqlaringizni yerga uring. Boladan sizga ergashishini so‘rang. Keyin unga boshchilik qilishga imkon bering.

407aee71-093f-47d5-be98-f518ebc93883.title: Pazl vaqti
407aee71-093f-47d5-be98-f518ebc93883.instructions: Bolaga 3-5 bo‘lakli oddiy pazl bering. Shakllarni moslashtirishiga yordam bering. Har bir bo‘lakni to‘g‘ri joylashtirganida uni maqtang.

ab3c62c3-5d7c-4ac6-ad8b-ac7d714a3ea7.title: Stikerlar bilan o‘yin
ab3c62c3-5d7c-4ac6-ad8b-ac7d714a3ea7.instructions: Bolaga stikerlar va qog‘oz bering. Stikerlarni ajratib olish mayda motorikani rivojlantiradi. Birgalikda rasm yarating.

62e05487-3056-4592-b1ea-0b4cac9e8f41.title: Tabiat qo‘ynida sayr
62e05487-3056-4592-b1ea-0b4cac9e8f41.instructions: Qisqa sayrga chiqing. Barglar, toshlar va gullarni yig‘ing. Ularning ranglari, shakllari va tuzilishi haqida suhbatlashing.

55dd9c21-79eb-44fa-92b7-7a1329f2835d.title: Nog‘ora chalish
55dd9c21-79eb-44fa-92b7-7a1329f2835d.description: Idishlar va qoshiqlar yordamida ritm yaratish
55dd9c21-79eb-44fa-92b7-7a1329f2835d.instructions: Idishlarni teskari qo‘yib, nog‘ora sifatida ishlating. Yog‘och qoshiqlardan nog‘ora tayoqchalari sifatida foydalaning. Birgalikda turli ritmlar yarating.

1edc1365-0580-41a0-86fb-6e413cd251cc.title: Guruchli sensor quti
1edc1365-0580-41a0-86fb-6e413cd251cc.description: Guruchni qo‘llar va turli vositalar yordamida o‘rganish
1edc1365-0580-41a0-86fb-6e413cd251cc.instructions: Idishni guruch bilan to‘ldiring. Stakanchalar, qoshiqlar va kichik o‘yinchoqlar qo‘shing. Bolaga guruchni olib solish, quyish va ichidan narsalarni izlashga imkon bering.

8055a758-49ff-45d1-880c-15da141896b2.title: Adyolda tebratish
8055a758-49ff-45d1-880c-15da141896b2.instructions: Ikki katta odam ichida chaqaloq yotgan adyolning burchaklaridan ushlaydi. Qo‘shiq aytib, uni ohista yon tomondan yon tomonga tebrating.

23d036b7-20b9-4a05-a223-49a6d472d380.title: Musiqa asboblari
23d036b7-20b9-4a05-a223-49a6d472d380.instructions:
1. Chaqaloqqa shaqildoq kabi xavfsiz musiqa asboblarini bering
2. Musiqa qo‘yib, unga mos ravishda asbobni silkiting
3. Birgalikda qo‘shiqlar kuylang
4. Chaqaloqqa turli tovushlarni o‘rganishga imkon bering

75be8860-ac3f-4a9e-87c7-5122de70d0a6.title: Sensorli shisha
75be8860-ac3f-4a9e-87c7-5122de70d0a6.description: Rangli suyuqlik bilan to‘ldirilgan shisha chaqaloqning diqqatini jalb qiladi
75be8860-ac3f-4a9e-87c7-5122de70d0a6.instructions: Plastik shishaga rangli suv yoki yaltiroq materiallar soling. Qopqog‘ini mahkam yoping. Chaqaloqqa ko‘rsating va dumalatishiga ruxsat bering.

f5161cf6-25f1-4eda-b672-91e0dc7075f4.title: Qo‘ldan ushlash va changallash
f5161cf6-25f1-4eda-b672-91e0dc7075f4.instructions: Chaqaloq changallashi uchun barmoqlaringizni uzating. Changallash kuchini rivojlantirish uchun sekin o‘zingizga torting.

d62cf27d-4570-4976-85c1-ea88d0004a93.title: Matolarni his qilish
d62cf27d-4570-4976-85c1-ea88d0004a93.instructions: Yumshoq, dag‘al, silliq va momiq matolarni to‘plang. Har birining tuzilishini aytib, chaqaloqqa ularni ushlab, his qilishiga imkon bering.

b0958c0b-1439-4e5e-8443-a1ae673d0845.title: Shaqildoqni silkitish
b0958c0b-1439-4e5e-8443-a1ae673d0845.description: Chaqaloq tovush chiqarish uchun shaqildoqni silkitadi
b0958c0b-1439-4e5e-8443-a1ae673d0845.instructions: Chaqaloqqa shaqildoq bering va uni qanday silkitishni ko‘rsating. Chaqaloq sizni takrorlaganida uni maqtang. Turli ritmlarni sinab ko‘ring.

2fb728ab-9f62-4c72-8288-051a6eb7e14e.title: Muz bo‘lakchalari bilan rasm chizish
2fb728ab-9f62-4c72-8288-051a6eb7e14e.description: Qog‘ozga rangli muz bo‘lakchalari bilan rasm chizing
2fb728ab-9f62-4c72-8288-051a6eb7e14e.instructions: Oziq-ovqat bo‘yog‘i qo‘shilgan suvni muzlatib qo‘ying. Chaqaloq rang-barang naqshlar yaratishi uchun muzni qog‘oz ustida yurgizishiga ruxsat bering.

4b4383db-2e14-4720-b060-17d8ff1704ee.title: Tuxum qutisi bilan saralash
4b4383db-2e14-4720-b060-17d8ff1704ee.description: Kichik buyumlarni tuxum qutisining kataklariga saralang
4b4383db-2e14-4720-b060-17d8ff1704ee.instructions: Xavfsiz kichik buyumlarni yaqinroqqa qo‘ying. Chaqaloqqa tuxum qutisining har bir katagiga bittadan buyum solishni ko‘rsating. Joylashtirish davomida sanab boring.

25a4322e-633e-4a3e-9979-250fedcd62b2.title: Karton uycha
25a4322e-633e-4a3e-9979-250fedcd62b2.instructions: Katta qutining deraza va eshiklarini kesib oching. Uni birgalikda bezating. Bolaga uycha ichida o‘ynashiga imkon bering.

ae4fecd1-f9d4-4188-aac6-c77af614920c.title: Tunneldan emaklab o‘tish
ae4fecd1-f9d4-4188-aac6-c77af614920c.instructions: Tunnel yasash uchun stullar ustiga ko‘rpachalarni yoping. Bolani tunneldan emaklab o‘tishga undang. Oxiriga o‘yinchoqlar qo‘ying.

64c0f7f0-7997-4646-84a7-28213e200807.title: Makaron marjon
64c0f7f0-7997-4646-84a7-28213e200807.instructions: Yirik naychasimon makaronlardan foydalaning. Bolaga ularni ip yoki poyabzal bog‘ichiga qanday tizishni ko‘rsating. Bu mayda motorikani rivojlantirish uchun juda foydali.

48b54a1e-5f01-444e-ac3a-7700916922cc.title: Barmoqlar bilan rasm chizish
48b54a1e-5f01-444e-ac3a-7700916922cc.instructions: Qog‘ozga xavfsiz bo‘yoq surting. Bolaga barmoqlari va qo‘llari bilan rasm yaratishiga imkon bering. Ranglar haqida suhbatlashing.

c6f840ec-4a7f-4cab-a710-22e0769b14e1.title: Kir yuvishda yordamchi
c6f840ec-4a7f-4cab-a710-22e0769b14e1.instructions: Turli rangdagi paypoqlarni aralashtirib qo‘ying. Chaqaloqdan rangiga qarab mos juftlarini topishini so‘rang.

236f386f-6b5f-4108-a856-812efa52e5d0.title: Soyalar o‘yini
236f386f-6b5f-4108-a856-812efa52e5d0.instructions: Qorong‘i xonada fonar yordamida devorda qo‘l soyalarini hosil qiling. Hayvonlar va buyumlar shaklini yarating.

3bde9afc-8036-426d-ae82-c76b546162fc.title: O‘yinchoqlarni yuvish
3bde9afc-8036-426d-ae82-c76b546162fc.instructions: Tog‘orani iliq sovunli suv bilan to‘ldiring. Chaqaloqqa gubka va yuvish uchun o‘yinchoqlar bering. Yuvish paytida har bir o‘yinchoqning nomini ayting.

97af70f2-c634-4bfa-bd72-86e31f80ae2a.title: Sanash o‘yini
97af70f2-c634-4bfa-bd72-86e31f80ae2a.instructions: Kubiklar kabi kichik buyumlarni to‘plang. Ularni birgalikda birma-bir sanang. 2, 3, 4 tadan guruhlarga ajrating.

ff72da83-28a7-4824-919d-7d40add23a69.title: Hayvonlarning ovozlari
ff72da83-28a7-4824-919d-7d40add23a69.instructions: Kitobdagi hayvonlar rasmlarini ko‘rsating. Har bir hayvonning ovoziga taqlid qiling. Chaqaloqni sizga taqlid qilishga undang.

7a752652-ca03-444b-9521-72269d1948b7.title: Yostiqlar tog‘i
7a752652-ca03-444b-9521-72269d1948b7.instructions: Yostiq va bolishlardan to‘siqlar yo‘lagini yasang. Chaqaloqni ularning ustidan oshib va orasidan o‘tishga undang.
